data.text: Gotcha (2026-10-29): Modrinth App 0.22 tracks every content file (sha1/size) in app.db `instance_files`. Overwriting mods/LivelyEyesBridge-0.1.0.jar(.disabled) and resourcepacks/LivelyEyes-0.1.0.zip outside the app on 10-28 13:58 left them as "changed outside the app" conflicts; duplicating the "26.1.2 MC optimized" instance (profile `Fabulously Optimized (2)`) fails with `restore or repair mods/LivelyEyesBridge-0.1.0.jar before duplicating`. Fix in-app: re-import / keep the on-disk file, not Repair (Repair restores the old 10-27 4106-byte build). Future installs: add or replace files through the app (drag-drop) instead of copying them into the profile. Backups of the 10-28 builds: ~/Downloads/lively-eyes-backup-2026-10-29 (jar sha1 cb1b385a, zip sha1 e9f63aff).
